cli.description: Local AI image generator (queue, attempts, chosen candidate and delivery).
cli.help.lang: language of the messages (default: the system's)
cli.cmd.project_add: register the project in a folder
cli.cmd.order_submit: create or update an order and queue its attempts
cli.cmd.order_list: list the orders of a project
cli.cmd.order_show: show an order with its attempts
cli.cmd.attempt_new: queue new attempts (random seed unless --seed is given)
cli.cmd.attempt_mark: mark an attempt as new, candidate or discarded
cli.cmd.attempt_note: set the note of an attempt
cli.cmd.choose: choose an attempt and deliver it to the project
cli.cmd.compose: compose an attempt again from its raw image, without generating (the chosen one is delivered again)
cli.arg.file: order JSON file, or - for standard input
cli.arg.attempt_optional: attempt number (default: the chosen one, else the last)
cli.arg.text_kv: text field to set, as FIELD=TEXT (repeatable; it is saved in the order)
cli.arg.chosen: only orders with a chosen attempt
cli.arg.unchosen: only orders without a chosen attempt
cli.arg.draft: generate drafts (smaller and fewer steps, D32); --no-draft forces final images
cli.out.composed_delivered: Composed attempt {id} and delivered it again: {path}
error.cli.text_invalid: "{value}" is not FIELD=TEXT (use for example --text title="My title")
error.compose.no_attempts: the order {order} ({profile}) has no attempts to compose
compose.log_failed: gimg: could not write the composition to the project log: {reason}
error.model.unknown: model "{model}" is not in the catalog (known models: {known})
error.model.required: the attempt does not say which model to use (known models: {known})
error.model.not_installed: model "{model}" is not installed; missing: {files}. Install it with: {command}
error.model.catalog_invalid: the model catalog "{path}" is not valid:
cli.cmd.doctor: check the installation (engine, models, tools) and say how to fix what is missing
cli.arg.verify: also check the sha256 of the installed models (slow: reads several GB)
doctor.summary_fail: Something failed: fix it with the commands above and run "gimg doctor" again.
doctor.launcher.not_in_path: the launcher is in {dir}, but that folder is not in PATH
doctor.launcher.missing: no "gimg" launcher in PATH or in {dir}
doctor.config.missing: {path} does not exist: the fake engine is used
doctor.engine.fake: configured engine: fake (test images, no sd-cli); real-engine items only warn
doctor.engine.unknown: unknown engine: "{engine}" (the values are fake and sdcpp)
doctor.machine.error: the machine profile cannot be loaded: {message}

doctor.libs.missing: no libggml* next to sd-cli, in {dir}: it will not start without them
doctor.models.catalog: the model catalog is not valid: {message}
doctor.model.size: model "{id}": {file} is {got} MB and the catalog says {want} MB (incomplete or different download)
doctor.model.sha: model "{id}": the sha256 of {file} does not match the catalog
doctor.model.ok_sha: model "{id}": installed, sizes and sha256 checked
doctor.model.ok_size: model "{id}": installed, sizes fine (sha256 not checked: use --verify)
doctor.memory.ok: free memory: {free} MB (the profile asks for {needed} MB)
doctor.memory.low: free memory: {free} MB and the profile asks for {needed} MB to generate
doctor.tool.missing: {tool} is not in PATH (needed to compose, D28; instalar.sh does not install it)
doctor.data.missing: the data folder {path} does not exist yet
doctor.data.unwritable: cannot write to the data folder {path}
doctor.flatpak.warn: XDG points into a flatpak folder ({vars}): gimg would use data {data} and configuration {config}, not the ones of a normal terminal
doctor.ollama.bad_url: the Ollama URL is not valid: {message}
doctor.ollama.loaded_unload: Ollama has {models} loaded; gimg will unload them when generating (engine.ollama: unload)
doctor.ollama.loaded: Ollama has {models} loaded: gimg will refuse to generate (engine.ollama: abort)
doctor.fix.python: install Python 3.10 or newer with your system package manager
doctor.fix.config: fix or delete {path}, then run instalar.sh again
doctor.fix.machine: check the machine profile (GIMG_MACHINE_PROFILE or machineProfile in config.json)
doctor.fix.memory: close what uses memory (game, browser, Ollama) before generating
doctor.fix.tool: install {tool} with your system package manager (apt: sudo apt install {apt}; Arch/SteamOS: sudo pacman -S {pacman})
doctor.fonts.missing: font "{font}" (used by {projects}) is not installed: the composed text would use another one
doctor.fonts.no_fc_list: fc-list (fontconfig) is not in PATH: the fonts of compose.fonts cannot be checked
doctor.fonts.fc_list_failed: fc-list (fontconfig) exists but failed ({reason}): the fonts of compose.fonts cannot be checked
doctor.fonts.project_error: fonts: the project "{project}" could not be read: {message}
doctor.fix.fonts: copy the font files (OFL: Sora, Inter, Cormorant Garamond, DM Sans...) to ~/.local/share/fonts and run: fc-cache -f
doctor.fix.flatpak: set the same folders in every terminal: {lines}
cli.cmd.measure: measure a brand image (luma and saturation, palette, distance to references, text contrast); numbers only, no verdict
cli.arg.image_path: image to measure (any path; it is only read)
cli.arg.refs: reference images for the EMD distance (one or more)
cli.arg.zone: text zone, as x,y,w,h in image pixels (goes with --text)
cli.arg.measure_project: project whose brand.palette is used when --palette is missing
cli.out.measure_palette: palette: {pct} % of pixels within ΔE < {delta} of {count} colours
cli.out.measure_contrast: contrast of {text} in zone {zone}: mean {mean}, p10 {p10}, p90 {p90}; worst {worst}:1
error.cli.measure_zone_text: --zone and --text go together: one of them is missing
error.measure.tool_missing: the tool "{tool}" is missing for measuring (install it; "gimg doctor" says how)
error.measure.timeout: {tool} took more than {seconds} s while measuring
error.measure.unreadable: cannot read the image "{path}" (it does not exist or ffmpeg does not understand it)
error.measure.no_brand_palette: project "{name}" has no brand.palette in its configuration: add one or pass --palette
error.measure.bad_zone: "{value}" is not an x,y,w,h zone of integers with positive width and height
error.measure.zone_outside: the zone {zone} falls outside the image ({width}x{height})
cli.cmd.sheet: contact sheet: several images in one PNG, each with its number and name, to review a round by reading a single image
cli.arg.sheet_images: images of the sheet, in order (only read)
cli.arg.sheet_out: output PNG (it cannot be one of the inputs)
cli.arg.sheet_width: width in pixels of each cell (default 640)
error.sheet.no_images: no images: pass at least one to "gimg sheet"
error.sheet.too_many: {count} images are too many for one sheet (maximum {max}): split the round into several sheets
error.sheet.bad_columns: "{value}" is not a valid number of columns (an integer of 1 or more)
error.sheet.bad_width: "{value}" is not a valid width (an integer between {min} and {max})
error.sheet.unreadable: cannot read the image "{path}" (it does not exist or ffmpeg does not understand it)
error.sheet.out_is_input: the output "{path}" is also one of the inputs: pick another --out so it is not overwritten
error.sheet.tool_missing: the tool "{tool}" is missing for making the sheet (install it; "gimg doctor" says how)
error.sheet.timeout: {tool} took more than {seconds} s while making the sheet
doctor.vram.ok: engine VRAM within what is safe for the Deck (at most {max} GB per device)
doctor.vram.high: "{where}" asks for --max-vram {value} and the Deck froze with high values (the steam-deck profile uses 2 GB; warning above {max})
doctor.vram.offload: "{where}" carries {arg} in its args: --offload-to-cpu and a --max-vram of its own froze the Deck
doctor.fix.vram: lower engine.maxVram to {max} or less and remove --offload-to-cpu / --max-vram from engine.models.<id>.args in the machine profile

cli.cmd.serve: local service: API and interface on 127.0.0.1 (with --detach, --status or --stop)
cli.arg.serve_port: port (default GIMG_PORT, the config or 8737; 0 = any free one)

cli.arg.serve_status: say whether the service is running (exit code 1 if not)
cli.arg.serve_stop: stop the running service (does not touch the worker)
